priorityActions.action: Add Weight Capacity to Bullet 2 — CRITICAL
priorityActions.description: Fitness equipment buyers MUST know weight capacity for safety. Current bullet 2 says 'reinforced steel tubing' and 'steady without wobble' but no lbs. Add 'Supports up to 300 lbs' or actual tested capacity.

priorityActions.action: Title Restructure — Lead with Adjustable Range
priorityActions.description: Current title: 'SogesPower Multi-Function Power Tower Pull Up Bar Station...' — height range buried. Restructure to lead with the adjustable range (65.7"-86.6") prominently. Also remove 'Multi-Function' repetition.
priorityActions.expectedLift: +3-5% CTR from search results with height-focused title

priorityActions.description: Cosmo Score 0 on assembly question — buyers actively search for this info. Add bullet: 'Freestanding — No Wall Mount Required. Sets up in minutes with anti-scratch floor protectors.'
priorityActions.expectedLift: +2-3% conversion by removing buyer uncertainty about installation

priorityActions.action: Add Warranty Claim for Premium Price
priorityActions.description: At $135.99, buyers expect warranty coverage. Add to bullet 2 or new bullet: '[1-Year Warranty] Backed by SogesPower quality guarantee.'
priorityActions.expectedLift: +1-2% conversion by reducing perceived purchase risk

priorityActions.description: 3.8 stars at 21 reviews is below category average. At this price point, buyers look for social proof. A small discount on a 'verified purchase' review campaign could help.

summary: Top 3 actions: (1) Add weight capacity to Bullet 2 — highest impact, (2) Restructure title with height range, (3) Add assembly/ease bullet to fill Cosmo gap. These three address the critical quality gaps identified.
